title: Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19084v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) uses feedback from model responses to improve prompts automatically. However, its effectiveness is usually measured through overall scores, which do not reveal which questions become correct, which previously correct answers become wrong, or whether improvements extend to unseen questions. We introduce Reflective Feedback-Driven Prompt Optimization (RFDPO), a tool that tracks recoveries (incorrect to correct), regressions (correct to incorrect), and churn (all changed outcomes). RFDPO uses this feedback to guide subsequent revisions and records prompt changes throughout optimization. We evaluate RFDPO across five benchmarks covering law, knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, and privacy, using GPT-5 as the optimizer and GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1 Mini as solvers. translated_title: 超越总体准确率：提示优化中的题目级转变
translated_abstract: 自动提示优化（APO）利用模型响应的反馈来自动改进提示。然而，其有效性通常通过总体分数来衡量，这种方式无法揭示哪些题目由错变对、哪些原本正确的答案变为了错误，以及改进是否能推广到未见过的题目。我们提出了反思式反馈驱动提示优化（RFDPO），这是一种追踪“恢复”（由错变对）、“退化”（由对变错）和“变动”（所有发生变化的结果）的工具。RFDPO 利用这些反馈来指导后续修订，并在整个优化过程中记录提示的变化。我们在涵盖法律、知识、指令遵循、数学和隐私五个领域的基准上评估了 RFDPO，使用 GPT-5 作为优化器，GPT-4o-mini 和 GPT-4.1 Mini 作为求解器。我们的结果表明，总体准确率可能掩盖显著的变化：在九个配置中的五个里，变动量至少是……的五倍（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出RFDPO方法，通过追踪提示优化过程中逐题的“恢复、退化与变动”转变，揭示总体准确率所掩盖的题目级变化，并利用这些反馈指导后续的提示修订。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RFDPO, which tracks item-level transitions (recoveries, regressions, and churn) during prompt optimization to expose changes hidden by aggregate accuracy and uses this feedback to guide subsequent prompt revisions.
